82:t_002:3.en:
$$店長$$
「They're the space pilots you're aiming to become...」

82:t_002:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Come on, you small fry. This Earth doesn't belong to you.」

82:t_002:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「If you think you can throw your weight around here forever, you're dead wrong!」

82:t_003:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「All they have is numbers...! What a nuisance!」

82:t_004:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...Looks like you've done it now, $$姫$$.」

82:t_004:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Clashing with the $$サイデリアル$$, no less. You're even more headstrong than usual, $$姫$$.」

82:t_004:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「It's not what you think, this is...」

82:t_004:4.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「It's fine. I don't like them either.」

82:t_004:5.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I'll lend a hand, $$姫$$. Let's finish the mission quickly and head back to $$メガネビュラ$$.」

82:t_005:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Enemies of this caliber... Maybe you didn't need my help after all.」

82:t_005:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「But... I was glad you came.」

82:t_005:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「By the way... who is that girl?」

82:t_005:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「The waitress from the shop earlier...」

82:t_005:6.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Thank you so much for saving me! $$ノノ$$ is so moved!」

82:t_005:7.en:
$$ラルク$$
「People help each other when they're in trouble.」

82:t_005:8.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's right! It is, isn't it! I expected no less of you, Big Sis~!」

82:t_005:9.en:
$$ノノ$$
「If you're ever in a pinch, Big Sis, $$ノノ$$ will definitely come help you too!」

82:t_005:10.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...So who is 'Big Sis' supposed to be...」

82:t_005:12.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You're a space pilot, aren't you, Big Sis?」

82:t_005:13.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...You. I thought you were from our world, but don't you recognize this uniform?」

82:t_005:15.en:
$$ラルク$$
「The $$フラタニティ$$ unit that intercepts $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

82:t_005:17.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's awesome! It fires me up! It seriously fires me up!」

82:t_005:19.en:
$$ノノ$$
「So that's a unit of justice that fights $$宇宙怪獣$$, right?」

82:t_005:21.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You're the champions of justice who protect everyone, right!?」

82:t_005:23.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ wants to be one too. I want to become a space pilot like you, Big Sis, and protect everyone!」

82:t_005:26.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Because $$ノノ$$ wants to become $$ノノリリ$$!!」

82:t_005:27.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Oh... You see, $$ノノリリ$$ is a person who...!」

82:t_006:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$サイデリアル$$...! They've sent out manned units!」

82:t_006:2.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「We'll teach you, Earthlings! Just how powerless you really are!」

82:t_006:3.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「So the adults and the $$サイデリアル$$ are the same, both unwilling to acknowledge our power...」

82:t_006:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Be careful, $$ニコラ$$! Here they come!」

82:t_007:1.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「Don't tell me this is...!?」

82:t_008:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Looks like the real target has finally shown up.」

82:t_009:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$宇宙怪獣$$...! They were hiding under the sand!」

82:t_009:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「There are more than expected...! I never thought this many had entered the atmosphere!」

82:t_009:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Wait, $$ニコラ$$...! Something else is coming!」

82:t_010:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「We detected combat and came to check, but...」

82:t_010:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「What the heck are those monsters...!?」

82:t_010:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Unit over there, can you hear me? Those are $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

82:t_010:4.en:
$n
「They seem to be a different type from what we've been fighting...」

82:t_010:6.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「No matching species. The $$人類銀河同盟$$ has never encountered that type.」

82:t_010:7.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Amateurs should stay out of this. Leave it to us and fall back.」

82:t_010:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「What the heck! I was going to lend you a hand!」

82:t_010:9.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I'm saying this for your own good. We'd like you to leave this to $$トップレス$$.」

82:t_010:10.en:
$$クルツ$$
「$$トップレス$$, you say!?」

82:t_010:11.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Do you know them, $$クルツ$$?」

82:t_010:12.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Do I know them? Are you kidding me...」

82:t_010:13.en:
$$恵子$$
「H-He's definitely got the wrong idea...!」

82:t_010:14.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Sorry to let down your expectations, $$クルツ$$, but those guys are something like a special unit that belongs to no organization.」

82:t_010:15.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「I hear they act on their own judgment and fight something, and it seems what they're fighting is those things called $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

82:t_010:17.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Since the enemy is $$宇宙怪獣$$, we can't overlook this. And to keep the city from harm, we also need to drive them off swiftly.」

82:t_010:18.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...I warned you. If you still insist on sticking your nose in, I won't be responsible for what happens.」

82:t_010:19.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You too, get out of here quickly. You're in the way.」

82:t_010:21.en:
$$ラルク$$
「If you don't want to die, hurry.」

82:t_010:23.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「$$ヴァンセット$$ will move to back up $$ディスヌフ$$.」

82:t_011:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Let's go, $$姫$$. Let's show them our power... the power of $$トップレス$$.」
